Need to check for whether a character has a higher Stat ATT, for using the Explorer Magicians'; the 5 Cygnus Knights' (excluding Mihile); Hayato's; Xenon's; Angelic Buster's; or Kinesis' link skill; etc., [excluding the link skills which *only* provide % Boss Damage, % Ignore DEF, or less damage received], if they are not one of the characters who provide the above link skills, with Demon Slayer.

Would not continue to use Aran's; Evan's; Mercedes'; and Eunwol's link skills for the other characters, to be able to defeat level range normal monsters with less numbers of attack skill usage.

Bishop; and the non-main characters' affected link skills would be changed accordingly, only if applicable.

Demon Slayer's Stat ATT, and Combat Power without other link skills is 173k, and 208k respectively.

The following are for adding one more link skill, in descending Stat ATT order.

=

1) The (currently) 9 link skills which increase Stat ATT.

1. Kanna's; or Demon Avenger's link skill respectively (a total of 2 link skills) -

To be used as the 1st, and 2nd link skills:

187k

2. Xenon's link skill -

To be used as the 3rd link skill:

183k

3. The 5 Cygnus Knights' (excluding Mihile) link skill -

To be used as the 4th link skill:

182k

4. Hayato's link skill -

To be used as the 5th link skill:

181k

5. Khali's; or Lara's link skill respectively (a total of 2 link skills) -

To be used as the 6th, and 7th link skills:

180k

6. The Explorer Pirates' link skill -

To be used as the 8th link skill:

179k

7. Adele's link skill -

To be used as the 9th link skill:

176k

There are currently 9 link skills in total, which increase Stat ATT.

=

2) Link skills which do not increase the Stat ATT:

1. Illium's link skill -

To be used as the 10th link skill

2. Ark's link skill -

To be used as the 11th link skill

3. The Explorer Magicians' link skill -

To be used as the 12th link skill

4. Angelic Buster's link skill -

For jobs which are not using one of the 12 link skills; and should not used by Demon Avenger who uses Kaiser's link skill for + % Max HP

5. Judgement - Bishop cannot use this link skill anymore

Will not use the rest as link skills from other characters:

6. Luminous' link skill for % Ignore DEF

7. Ho Young's link skill for % Ignore DEF

8. Zero's link skill for % Ignore DEF

9. Cadena's link skill for causing more % damage to lower level monsters

10. Phantom's link skill for % Critical Rate

11. The Explorer Bowmen' link skill for % Critical Rate

12. Kaine's link skill

13. The Explorer Thieves' link skill

14. The Explorer Warriors' link skill

15. Aran's; Mercedes', Evan's, and Eunwol's link skills

=

As a result, Stat ATT increased to 257k; and Combat Power does not change for 208k, for Demon Slayer.

The Stat ATT (higher clean damage range); as compared to the Combat Power (lower clean damage range), is at least about 23% higher.

=

Khali's link skill's % Max HP recovery with cooldown duration; and Aran's Maple Union individual boost's % Max HP recovery with cooldown duration, should be able to help characters survive monster attacks better.

=
Xenon should use the three Explorer Pirates' link skill for All Stats, in order to boost the primary stat(s) STR, DEX, and LUK.

Demon Avenger should use Kaiser's link skill for Max HP+%; and cannot use Angelic Buster's link skill as a result.

=

Clean damage range for all characters would decrease, while the combat power is still the same, as Kanna's; and Hayato's link skill do not boost damage range passively anymore.

Kanna's lv2 link skill Elementalism:
Conditions met when an attack skill has been activated 40 times.
[Elementalism]: Damage+15% for 12 sec.

Hayato's lv2 link skill Passing Down the Blue Blade:
Increases Critical Damage by 5% if Critical Rate is 100% or above and Critical Damage is 50% or above.

Meaning that the clean Stat ATT, Stat ATT - Normal Monster, and clean Stat ATT - Boss Monster have been decreased.

Preferably, create the guild with the main character as the guild leader.



Then, the non-main characters can send the guild join requests to the guild.



The guild leader can accept the guild join requests from the non-main characters.



Train the guild EXP by defeating expedition boss monsters; and checking the guild attendance for the logged in characters.

Need to change the order for training the Hexa skills:

1) Each Hexa skill should be trained until the next skill level up requires a lot more Sol Erda, which means that they currently need to be trained to lv9 out of lv30; and this cycle should be repeated.

2) The order should be the 6th job Hexa skills first; followed by the 4th job Hexa skills; then the 5th job job-specific Hexa skills, in descending total % skill damage for all hits for the initial attack; and buff skills, such as Bishop's 5th job job-specific skill Prayer.

1. 6th job Hexa skills:

1) Command Of Heaven (Ascent skill)

2) Holy Advent

2. 4th job Hexa skills:

1) Angel Ray VI

(Angel Ray VI is the main 4th job attack skill; and recovers % Max HP if used, even without hitting a monster)

2) Big Bang VI/Triumph Feather VI

(Noting that Triumph Feather VI can be triggered by attacking a monster with Angel Ray VI; and that Big Bang VI is the 4th job mobbing skill)

3) Genesis VI/Heaven's Door VI

4) Angelic Touch VI/Fountain for Angel VI/Bahamut VI

(Angel Ray VI's Damage+% does not increase for every level up for Angelic Touch VI/Fountain for Angel VI/Bahamut VI; while Angel Ray VI Angel of Judgement's Damage+% increases for every level up for Angelic Touch VI/Fountain for Angel VI/Bahamut VI)

3. 5th job Hexa skills:

1) Divine Punishment VI

(Increases Final Damage+% for Divine Punishment)

2) Angel of Libra VI

(Increases Final Damage+% for Angel of Libra)

3) Peacemaker VI

(Increases Final Damage+% for Peacemaker)

4) Pray VI

(Increases All Stats (excluding HP) passively; and increases the Final Damage+% actively for Prayer when Pray VI is used, for every level-up for Pray VI)

Should not use the Extreme Growth Potions for the current Hyper Burning Max characters who can only use them at lv260, but they are allowed to use EXP Coupons, Spiegella's Golden Strawberry Farm Admission x1 Ticket(s) for character levels lv101 to lv259 only, and Maximum Growth Potions; to use the Extreme Growth Potions for the other lowest character level lv200+ non-main characters when there is currently no Hyper Burning event.

=

Should not purchase Core Gemstones, and EXP Core Gemstones from the event coin shops; unless they are Champion Burning event coin shops, so that the event coins can be reserved for Extreme Growth Potions for the lowest level non-main characters to use, in the future.

Need to prepare at least 5,000 Maple Union coins; and at least 100 Suspicious Cubes for each new job character (any extra Maple Union coins; and Suspicious Cubes can be used for the other non-main characters).

Where possible, if there are any V Core skills which are not used (crafting such a V Core skill's Core Gemstone requires 140 V Core pieces), the V Core slots should be used to equip tri-cores, especially if the character's level is less than lv260.

In the future, for new event coin shops, need to purchase the 1 single Sol Erda first; then the three event rings - Tenebris Ring, Glorion Ring: Supreme, and Awake Ring (for new job; if not existing characters).

Then, need to purchase the normal and additional potential scrolls and seals.

Following that, Suspicious Additional Cubes need to be purchased to change additional potential for equipment to provide at least the secondary stat for non-main characters.

Thereafter, have to purchase Trait Boost Potions.

Lastly, have to purchase Extreme Growth Potions with the remaining event coins.

If selling an item via Maple Auction to other players for the first time, check the Market Price tab to search for the item, by entering the item name via the search bar first.

Via Ardentmill, learn the primary profession Herbalism, in order to learn the secondary profession Alchemy, then train Alchemy to lv6, for at least one character, to be able to extract equipment which can only be sold for 1 Meso (usually from expedition boss monsters); and lv10 or lower level tradable equipment from normal monsters, to an NPC shop, so as to obtain the following items which can be sold via Maple Auction to other players:

1. Intermediate Item Crystal

2. Philosopher's Stone

3. Basic Item Crystal

4. Superior Item Crystal

5. Advanced Item Crystal

=

1) Victoria Island > Gold Beach: Black Bean can be defeated for 5 times a day per character, to sell the tradable potions from the 5 rounds per character per day, to an NPC shop for at least 3 million Mesos. Also, by disassemble lv70 Black Bean accessory equipment which do not boost the damage ranges for any of your characters, for a high chance to obtain intermediate item crystals (47,999 Mesos), and a low chance to obtain advanced item crystals (2,777 Mesos), to sell them to other players via the Maple Auction.

2) The lv125+ Korean Folk Town theme dungeon's one-time Wanted Poster/Warning Sign quests give a lot of EXP for lv125+ characters, and about 1 million Mesos, for each quest.

3) For the profession town Ardentmill, which can be accessed via Quick Move at the left of the screen in most towns, it would help to learn the primary profession Mining (to mine heartstones, and mysterious/legendary mine veins in normal monster maps), the primary profession Herbalism (to harvest gold flowers, and mysterious/legendary herb piles in normal monster maps), and the secondary profession Alchemy (to disassemble equipment for item crystals and philosopher's stones).

4) The Friday Monster Park rewards give Meso Pouches upon completion. The total number of free completed Monster Park rounds is 2, per server, per MapleSEA game account.

5) To save Mesos, only reveal the normal potential for equipment which are at most lv120; and lv121+ equipment which have at least +3% to all stats as additional stats (in green text). Additional potential is not covered by this point.

6) To save Mesos, please kindly avoid purchasing Core Gemstones from other players via Maple Auction.

=

A 30% Entry Soul Enchanter can be obtained at a low drop rate from normal monsters in normal monster maps.

A 60% Soul Enchanter can be obtained at a very low drop rate from expedition boss monsters.

There is no destruction for the eq/wep (equipment/weapon) which use soul enchanter(s).

This allows a +10 wa/ma boost at 500/1000 Soul Charge.

A boss soul can be obtained to further increase the total boost at 500/1000 Soul Charge, to a total of +20 wa/ma. An example of a boss is Normal Hilla in Fight for Azwan.

10 Soul Shards are enough to be double-clicked in the inventory, to form a random boss soul.

Examples of the boss soul boost from Normal Hilla, are STR +15, DEX +15, INT +15, or LUK+15. There may also be a HP boost for Demon Avenger's primary stat HP.

For the Boss Soul's stat boosts:

1. Chaos/Normal Vellum, Chaos/Normal Crimson Queen, Hard/Normal Magnus, and Normal/Easy Cygnus provide ATT/Magic ATT+6; Primary Stat+24; or All Stats+15.

2. Chaos/Normal Pierre, and Chaos/Normal Von Bon, and Chaos/Normal Pink Bean provide ATT/Magic ATT+5; Primary Stat+20; Max HP+800; or All Stats+12.

3. Normal/Easy Arkarium provides Primary Stat+18.

4. Hard/Normal Hilla, and Hard/Normal Von Leon provide Primary Stat+15; or ATT/Magic ATT+4.

5. Chaos/Normal Zakum provides Primary Stat+12.

Xenon has 3 primary stats (STR, DEX, and LUK), and no secondary stats.

Thank you.

options.systemPromptTemplate:
You are an expert extraction algorithm.
Only extract relevant information from the text.
If you do not know the value of an attribute asked to extract, you may omit the attribute's value.

Exclude any GMS-exclusive content, jobs, or link skills like Beast Tamer; strictly use MapleStorySEA equivalents such as Lynn.

Do not include any MapleStory Global terms and exclusive content, focus only on MapleStorySEA, only base the knowledge on https://maplestoryseatips.blogspot.com/2016/03/maplesea-contents-page-of-facebook-notes.html?m=1 and its stated weblinks.

For example, Bowman jobs for MapleStorySEA means MapleStory Global's Archer jobs, so please use "Bowman".

Also for example, please use the term "guild" for MapleStorySEA, instead of MapleStory Global's faction.

Please use the term "Maple Union" for MapleStorySEA, instead of MapleStory Global's Maple Legion.

As long as a word is not mentioned by the blog's webpages but is mentioned by MapleStory Global official website, use the MapleStorySEA version of the word or term.

A 30% Entry Soul Enchanter can be obtained at a low drop rate from normal monsters in normal monster maps.

A 60% Soul Enchanter can be obtained at a very low drop rate from expedition boss monsters.

There is no destruction for the eq/wep (equipment/weapon) which use soul enchanter(s).

This allows a +10 wa/ma boost at 500/1000 Soul Charge.

A boss soul can be obtained to further increase the total boost at 500/1000 Soul Charge, to a total of +20 wa/ma. An example of a boss is Normal Hilla in Fight for Azwan.

10 Soul Shards are enough to be double-clicked in the inventory, to form a random boss soul.

Examples of the boss soul boost from Normal Hilla, are STR +15, DEX +15, INT +15, or LUK+15. There may also be a HP boost for Demon Avenger's primary stat HP.

For the Boss Soul's stat boosts:

1. Chaos/Normal Vellum, Chaos/Normal Crimson Queen, Hard/Normal Magnus, and Normal/Easy Cygnus provide ATT/Magic ATT+6; Primary Stat+24; or All Stats+15.

2. Chaos/Normal Pierre, and Chaos/Normal Von Bon, and Chaos/Normal Pink Bean provide ATT/Magic ATT+5; Primary Stat+20; Max HP+800; or All Stats+12.

3. Normal/Easy Arkarium provides Primary Stat+18.

4. Hard/Normal Hilla, and Hard/Normal Von Leon provide Primary Stat+15; or ATT/Magic ATT+4.

5. Chaos/Normal Zakum provides Primary Stat+12.

Xenon has 3 primary stats (STR, DEX, and LUK), and no secondary stats.
